name: Elixirs for the Bladeleafs
label: Quest
description: In the boughs of Dolanaar, Syral Bladeleaf seeks an alchemist to restock her family's burgeoning trade. Her husband spends endless hours over brewing…
intro: In the boughs of Dolanaar, Syral Bladeleaf seeks an alchemist to restock her family's burgeoning trade. Her husband spends endless hours over brewing cauldrons, and Syral hopes a batch of fresh elixirs will lighten his workload and earn the contributor a bundle of rare herbs.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Our herb and alchemy shop is booming, but my husband spends so much time mixing potions that we never have time for each other.
If you can bring me a supply of pre-made elixirs, then I would be happy to trade with you. I have some rare herbs that you might find useful.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. Do you have the elixirs to trade?

clips.title: Completion
paras: These are nicely mixed. You take great care in your trade, friend, and that is important for an alchemist.
Here are your herbs, freshly gathered. May you use them well.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
